paper_title: First Constraints on the Photon Coupling of Axion-like Particles from Multimessenger Studies of the Neutron Star Merger GW170817
notes: Headline result: the purple 'Fermi-LAT (this work)' 95% CL exclusion region in the (m_a, g_agamma) plane, Fig. 4, derived from Fermi-LAT observations of GW170817 (merger remnant assumed to survive 1 s). Extracted as vector coordinates from figures/limits.pdf (drawing index 5, purple fill (0.6,0.2,0.6)). Axis calibration verified against Benchmark 1 red square (m_a=398 MeV, g=5.01e-11) and Benchmark 2 purple triangle (m_a=200 MeV, g=1.41e-12). This is a CLOSED 2D excluded region, not a single upper-limit curve; the points trace the boundary as a loop starting at the low-mass upper edge (m=0.01 MeV, g~1e-7, top of plot frame = frame-clip; region extends above), along the upper (large-g) boundary to the high-mass tip near m~110 MeV, g~7e-12, then back along the lower (small-g) boundary to m=0.01 MeV, g~4.4e-10. Region clipped on the left at the frame edge m=0.01 MeV (the fill continues off-frame to ~1 keV, an artifact). Not a dark-matter search, so no density rescaling (dm_density_assumed=null). Dashed purple 'stacked' and 'x10 closer' curves and black 'future' curves are projections and are NOT included. Lagrangian convention L = -(1/4) g_agamma a F Ftilde matches the canonical AxionPhoton definition (Eq. 1).
